notes: All probabilities are Monte Carlo counts from column-normalized Gaussian matrices and independent random supports/signs. Exact recovery is solved by linear programming with relative-scale tolerance 1e-5. ERC tests max_j||A_I^+ a_j||1<1. Weak ERC uses the Neumann-series bound max_j||A_Iᵀa_j||1 / (1-||A_IᵀA_I-I||1)<1, requiring a positive denominator. Fuchs tests the sign-specific off-support certificate. Finite trial counts are stated; these are not asymptotic threshold curves.
